recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-43379; future changes to this condition element should be made in the OO Incubator source that now owns SupplyDelivery.
issue_request: FHIR-43379 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request to update the short description and long definition for the SupplyDelivery condition element. The Jira title says SupplyDelivery.condition, but the Jira description and OO minutes identify the intended element as SupplyDelivery.suppliedItem.condition.
initial_application: Commit c710afe97d applied the requested short and definition to source/supplydelivery/structuredefinition-SupplyDelivery.xml. FHIR-44996 later converted the same element to CodeableConcept and added an example condition value set; the related FHIR-44996 reconciliation commit already fixed the remaining stale CodeSystem description.
additional_context: Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyDelivery from active core build metadata in source/fhir.ini and updated current core narrative/module pages to link SupplyDelivery to the OO Incubator IG. The current external OO Incubator StructureDefinition-SupplyDelivery JSON carries the same FHIR-43379 short and definition, and no Zulip or later Jira evidence was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. An empty external-repo audit commit was published because editing source/supplydelivery would not affect the current core build and the external artifact that now owns SupplyDelivery is already correct for this issue.

related_jiras.note: Applied issue that added SupplyDelivery.suppliedItem.condition as CodeableConcept with an example value set; it explains the current type/binding around the FHIR-43379 wording and is already represented on the combined branch.
